lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Five vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible on the mid-lateral flank, arranged in a structured geometric grid. Each column contains 3-4 distinct nodes of elevated intensity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and a shadow-cast gradient on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, low-contrast high-luminance blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the dorsal fin, primarily concentrated toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged edges and small indentations are visible on the distal trailing margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-frequency distribution of minute high-luminance spots on the dorsal cephalic region, transitioning into larger, lower-frequency blobs on the posterior flank.
